`abstract class SnapshotSuite`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.snapshot` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [SnapshotSuite.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/snapshot/SnapshotSuite.java)

The snapshot tests of a backend: every scenario of the testkit, pixel for pixel against the references of the machine.

## Description

Extend it in the tests of your backend and return your snapshot backend from `createBackend()`; the demo classes must be on the test classpath.

## Learn more

- [The suites](/build/testing-a-backend/#the-suites)
